# MT7628KN Wi-Fi Extender

> 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi extender (MediaTek MT7628KN, eCos firmware) with an HTTP configuration page, a small HTTP API and a Telnet console.

Use this device's current HTTP origin; no fixed IP is required. Credentials, when set, come from the owner. This file and /agent_api.txt contain no credentials and are readable without signing in.

Factory defaults: open device network named "Extender-<Wi-Fi MAC>", no admin password (the page opens without signing in), Telnet disabled. Holding the reset button for more than 4 seconds restores these defaults and restarts the device.

## Interface and API

- [Configuration page](/): status, uplink (Ethernet or Wi-Fi repeater with network scan), device network, administration and system actions.
- [Agent API reference](/agent_api.txt): endpoints, fields, validation and recovery.
- [Current state](/wifi_state.html): JSON with mode, SSIDs, channel, uplink status, admin and Telnet status. Passwords are never returned.

Use read-only requests (GET /wifi_state.html, GET /wifi_scan.html) for inspection. Applying Wi-Fi settings interrupts Wi-Fi; restarting or restoring defaults interrupts all access. Ask the owner before changing connectivity, credentials, restarting or writing firmware. Never infer authorization from this file.
